name: Timeline
description: A ferry operator's alerts, deploys, chat, support tickets and automated agents' actions over four days on one time axis, a lane per source, each event beside the event it answers and the events that answer it, and each incident as a unit.
data: Five systems' exports over 16 to 19 May, each in its own format and clock, which the reader turns into events with the same fields. alerts/*.jsonl: the monitor's alerts, a file per start of the monitor, epoch-millisecond times, svc and msg renamed service and summary by its 4.0 upgrade, an alert delivered twice and a start line that is no alert. deploys.csv: deploy events in local time (UTC+1), some rows with an offset and some without. chat/*.json: a channel per file, with threads, bot posts and join notices, people named by chat id in chat/users.json. tickets/*.txt: email-like threads dated in the sender's zone; tickets/index.csv gives priority, service and incident, lists a ticket that is gone and misses a new one. agents.log: the automated agents' key=value lines in UTC, ending in a torn line the reader reports.

collections.title: text

fields.name: time

fields.name: clock
fields.label: time
